dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The trace demonstrated rigorous adherence to orchestration rules and governance standards, initializing via rules-context-loader and executing five approved ADR-to-pattern transformations. Every span concluded with a schema_validation_success event and status ok without failures.

dimensions.rationale: Causal continuity was maintained across all steps, propagating rule context systematically to derive structured, cohesive patterns from ADR requirements with clear causal linkages and depth.
